author: Forbes
description:
Stephen Curry was the NBA’s first unanimous MVP, in 2016. The first player to lead the league in 3-pointers four times, then five times, then six and seven and eight times. The first player to launch 10,000 attempts from beyond the arc—and the first to drain 4,000 of them.

But for all of the ways the Golden State Warriors’ 38-year-old sharpshooter has transformed basketball, he is just as much of a game-changer financially.

Already the first NBA player with a $40 million salary (in 2019-20) and a $50 million salary (2023-24), Curry is set to cross the $60 million threshold this season, banking $62.6 million on the court. Meanwhile, after splitting with his longtime sponsor Under Armour last fall and unveiling a new deal with Chinese shoe brand Li-Ning in June, Curry projects to earn an estimated $141 million from endorsements and other business endeavors—demolishing the NBA-record $100 million he made off the court in 2024-25.

title: Highest-Paid NBA Players 2026: Curry Is Basketball’s First $200 Million Man

description:
Ooni vs. Gozney: Which outdoor pizza oven is actually worth your money? Forbes Vetted executive editor Dave Johnson puts the Ooni Koda 2 Pro and Gozney Arc XL head-to-head to find out which one delivers the best pizza-making experience.

After making dozens of pizzas, Dave compares these two premium outdoor pizza ovens across six key categories: setup, ease of use, footprint, versatility, cooking results and price. From achieving the perfect crispy, charred crust to testing temperature control and overall performance, he breaks down where each oven shines—and where it falls short.

Whether you're a seasoned home pizza maker or looking to upgrade your backyard setup, we put both ovens to the test to help you decide which one is worth the investment.
